name: cpi
description: FSRS-based competitive programming problem review for VS Code.

cpi.problemsetPath.description: Problemset folder path. Empty means the current workspace root.

cpi.autoOpenCpp.description: Create and open a C++ review file for normal reviews.

cpi.openMarkdownPreviewToSide.description: Open the rendered Markdown problem preview to the side.

cpi.templateCppPath.description: Default template.cpp path used when creating review C++ files.

cpi.openOriginalUrl.description: Open the original problem URL in the default browser when a problem starts.

cpi.autoAdvanceAfterRating.description: Automatically start the next due problem after rating the current problem.

cpi.strictTwoEditorTabs.description: Close the previous CPI-opened Markdown and C++ editors before opening the next problem.

cpi.reopenPreviousEditorsOnUndo.description: After undoing a review, reopen the previous problem's Markdown and the same C++ file used for that review.
